column1: # every row shot whole on this build when the gate came to hold each line to its width, which the column before the letters records: no line moved more than half a point down or across from the row it replaces, none was lost and none found anew, and seven sidebar CVs' medians and p90s moved with lines that stayed within that half point. Shot in two sittings of Word, every line came out at the same width to the hundredth
